== Biography ==
{{Died Young}}
Eliza was born about 1844. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-987|Thomas Glasgow]] and [[McCraken-44|Maryann unknown]].<ref>http://www.census.nationalarchives.ie/pages/1851/Antrim/Kilconway/Rasharkin/Lisnagaver/37/</ref>

She died of Inflamation, aged 1.
== Research Notes ==

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-987]] is assessed at 98% (proved). The older Eliza’s death estimate is unsupported, but her recorded baptism clearly identifies this parental couple.

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.
